overview_description.description: UPchieve is an educational technology foundation that connects moderate high school students with free, on-demand live tutors and therapists at any time. Their online platform is accessible around the clock and can easily connect students with their qualified academic coaches. They have aided kids in getting the tutoring and college guidance they required to succeed academically.

about_short_description.short_description: UPchieve is an ed-tech nonprofit helping high school students connect to free on-demand live tutors and counselors.

product.name: Free Online Tutoring
product.description: Provides 1-on-1 academic support in various subjects including Math, Science, Reading, Writing, and test prep for SAT & ACT, available 24/7.

product.name: College Counseling
product.description: Offers guidance on college applications, essay writing, and identifying best-fit colleges to help students get into their dream schools.

product.name: Volunteer Tutoring Program
product.description: Allows individuals to volunteer as tutors, providing academic support to students in need at any time that fits their schedule.

product.name: School Partnerships
product.description: Collaborates with schools to provide free, unlimited tutoring and college counseling to students, helping improve their academic performance.
